# ARBYNEX

> ARBYNEX is an AI automation agency and full-service software company. We build AI chatbots, business automation systems, custom software, SaaS platforms and enterprise solutions for modern businesses worldwide. Every client gets a free working demo before paying.

Key facts:
- What it is: an AI automation agency and full-service software company.
- What we build: AI chatbots (WhatsApp, Instagram, website), business automation, lead capture systems, custom software, web apps, mobile apps, SaaS products, e-commerce platforms and enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, POS).
- Founder & developer: Muhammad Arbaz — he personally builds every project, so clients work directly with the developer.
- Risk-free model: a working demo is built for your business first; you pay only after you have seen it working.
- Pricing: simple automations from $150; AI chatbots and systems $300–$1,000+; custom software from $500; complex SaaS and enterprise $2,000–$20,000+. Monthly support plans available. Fixed quotes.
- Delivery: most systems go live in 3–7 days; MVPs in 1–3 weeks; complex SaaS in 4–8 weeks; enterprise in 6–12 weeks.
- Tech stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (frontend); Node.js, NestJS, Python, Django (backend); PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (databases); Docker, CI/CD, cloud (DevOps); LLMs, AI Agents (AI).
- Industries: Retail, e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, education, professional services, startups, growing businesses.
- Serves clients worldwide: US, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, EU, Pakistan. Languages: English and Urdu.
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 319 6926996; email a4arbazchaudhary@gmail.com.

## Services
- [AI Chatbots](https://arbynex.com/#ai): WhatsApp, Instagram and website bots powered by GPT/Claude that answer customers instantly, 24/7, in any language.
- [Business Automation](https://arbynex.com/#ai): lead capture, communication automation, workflow automation and document automation.
- [Custom Software](https://arbynex.com/#services): purpose-built business management systems, internal platforms, workflow systems and custom dashboards.
- [Web Applications](https://arbynex.com/#services): modern React/Next.js web apps, customer portals, admin panels, SaaS platforms and API-driven applications.
- [Mobile Applications](https://arbynex.com/#services): iOS & Android apps, cross-platform apps and mobile-integrated systems.
- [SaaS Products](https://arbynex.com/#services): complete subscription-based products with multi-tenant architecture, auth, billing, payments and analytics.
- [E-commerce Platforms](https://arbynex.com/#services): online stores, custom commerce, payment integration, inventory and order management.
- [Enterprise Systems](https://arbynex.com/#services): CRM, ERP, POS, inventory, reporting, analytics and business intelligence.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://arbynex.com/#tech): cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring and deployment automation.

## FAQ
- **What does ARBYNEX do?** AI automation agency and software company — AI chatbots, business automation, custom software, SaaS and enterprise systems.
- **Do I get a demo before paying?** Yes — a working demo is built for your business first. You pay only after seeing it work.
- **What technologies do you use?** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, CI/CD, LLMs, AI Agents.
- **How long does a project take?** Automations: 3–7 days. MVPs: 1–3 weeks. Complex SaaS: 4–8 weeks. Enterprise: 6–12 weeks.
- **How much does it cost?** Automations from $150. Custom software from $500. Enterprise up to $20,000+. Fixed quotes.
- **What industries do you serve?** Retail, e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, education, professional services, startups.
- **Do you provide ongoing support?** Yes — post-launch support and monthly partnership plans.
